delta_note: Ph = max(0, cum_now - cum_prev) within the same Madrid calendar day. If cum drops (midnight reset or station reset), Ph = max(0, cum_now) and the previous cumulative is ignored (new baseline). The first sample for a station after (re)start sets Ph = 0 so we do not invent rain before the first capture. Hours before the archive starts are absent — never fabricated.
